definitions.explanation: A forest with very thick, closely packed vegetation. Often refers to tropical jungles or any heavily wooded area that is difficult to penetrate.

examples.japanese: {密林|みつりん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
アマゾン⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{密林|みつりん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{未知|みち}→未知：13014_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生物|せいぶつ}→生物：03295_seibutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are unknown creatures in the Amazon jungle.

examples.japanese: {密林|みつりん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{分|わ}け{入|い}る⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{巨大|きょだい}→巨大：02586_kyodai⟧な⟦{滝|たき}→滝：02219_taki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{現|あらわ}した→現す：02097_arawasu⟧。
examples.english: When we pushed deep into the jungle, a massive waterfall came into view.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{密|みつ}→密：03777_mitsu⟧ (dense, thick) + {林|りん} (forest, woods). Evokes an image of lush, impenetrable vegetation. In modern Japanese slang, {密林|みつりん} is sometimes used as a nickname for Amazon (the company), playing on the meaning 'jungle.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密林|みつりん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探検|たんけん}→探検：17461_tanken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to explore the jungle
- {密林|みつりん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧: deep in the jungle
- ⟦{熱帯|ねったい}→熱帯：03531_nettai⟧{密林|みつりん}: tropical jungle
- {密林|みつりん}⟦{地帯|ちたい}→地帯：04057_chitai⟧: jungle zone

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ジャングル→ジャングル：05496_janguru⟧: jungle (loanword; more casual and common in everyday speech)
- ⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧: forest (general term; not necessarily dense)
- ⟦{原生林|げんせいりん}→原生林：09965_genseirin⟧: virgin forest, old-growth forest (emphasis on being untouched)
